answer: The price of cheating is written in the book before any cheat arrives, so no one can plead surprise. Ironmonger stock book with ironmongers attestation is where the price is written: nine-year book, 6,000 hundredweight stocked, nail accounts, yearly fees. Cheat with a counterfeit plume and the price is exacted at once, twice the value of the goods plus the dune as a fine, while the ocean is recorded in the book and read when the year turns.
